task: Cora node classification with a two-layer GCN under 30% uniform label noise

dataset.name: Cora Planetoid
dataset.source: Planetoid Cora files used by common GCN/NoisyGL Cora experiments

baseline.name: NoisyGL GCN on Cora, 30% uniform noise
baseline.source: NoisyGL NeurIPS 2024 Table A1 reports GCN Cora 30% uniform noise accuracy 71.06 +/- 4.39 over 10 runs
baseline.notes: The paper anchor is the original 200-epoch benchmark result. This AgentHPOBench task uses a fixed 80-epoch budget with the same data split/noise task and normalizes toward the paper anchor.
